name: the_wall_between_two_holes_is_measured_as_asked
why: Z-C21, finding M29, measured REAL by Z-C21.3 on 28/9/2026 (probe_measure_arc_option). misura_fra_entita (OperazioniMisura.cs) never set IMeasure.ArcOption nor ProjectionOption, and between arcs or circles «distance» is three different numbers: IMeasure~ArcOption.html, «How to measure an arc or circle as defined by swMeasureArcCircleOption_e» (0 centre to centre, 1 minimum, 2 maximum). Unset, the measure took option 0 and published the distance between the axes as «distanza_mm», with nothing saying which distance it was. The fix takes «arc_measure» (centre, minimum, maximum; centre by default, the old behaviour), sets ArcOption and ProjectionOption = 0 before Calculate as the guide example does, reads ArcOption back and publishes it.
defect_caught: The wall between two holes asked for and the distance between their axes given instead (35 asked, 50 given: the old library ignores «arc_measure»); an option set and not taken; a name outside the three accepted as if it were the default.
_and_the_twin_is_in_the_same_file: The last step is the refusal and step 2 is its twin: the same two faces with «arc_measure» «minimum»; only that argument differs.
_the_numbers: Plate 100 x 60 x 10 on the front plane, holes D10 at x = -25 and D20 at x = +25, as in the probe: volume 60000 - pi x (25 + 100) x 10 = 56073.0092 mm3 (the probe read 56073.0092). Between the two cylindrical faces the probe read Distance 50 with ArcOption 0 (and unset), 35 with 1, 65 with 2, and CenterDistance 50 with all three: 50 - 5 - 10 = 35 between the nearest points, 50 + 5 + 10 = 65 between the farthest. A fresh IMeasure reads ArcOption 0 and ProjectionOption 0, and the option set on one measure does not stick to the next (step 5 of the probe). SOLIDWORKS may split a hole wall in two half cylinders: the probe took one of each and still read 35 and 65, because both halves reach the points on the line of the centres.

expect.tolerance_why: 60000 - 3926.991 = 56073.009: the hundredth covers the rounding; a plate without one of the holes would be 785 or 3142 mm3 away
